name: @w6w-apps/betterstack
description: Manage Better Stack Uptime: monitors, heartbeats, incidents, on-call calendars and status pages.

w6w.longDescription:
Better Stack Uptime monitors websites, ports, cron jobs and APIs, pages the on-call person when something breaks, and publishes the status page customers read. This app drives that Uptime API from a workflow.

Create, pause, update and delete monitors and heartbeats; read their availability and response times; open, acknowledge, resolve and reopen incidents and read their timelines and comments; look up who is on call and the escalation policies behind them; and read status pages, their resources and their published reports.

Monitor reads are scrubbed: a proxy password, environment variable or Authorization header a user typed into a monitor is redacted before it reaches a workflow's run record. The Better Stack Telemetry API (logs and metrics) is a separate product and is not part of this app.
